title: The same total intensity becomes Vajra energy when silence returns at once and ordinary anger when agitation lingers
body:
- A Zen master's katsu requires mobilizing complete vital energy (Qi) in a single instant to produce a shock that shatters dualistic thinking.
- A practitioner using true Vajra energy returns to absolute silence the moment the shout ends.
- Lingering agitation after the mobilization is the diagnostic that ordinary anger was discharged instead of Vajra precision.
- The peak intensity is the same in both cases; only what happens after reveals which energy was actually at work.
conversion: The identical peak intensity becomes Vajra energy when followed by instant silence and ordinary anger when any agitation remains.
